title: Aleutian Adventures
specs: Remote Alaska Peninsula locations with wild, ocean-bright king salmon, silver salmon, and steelhead
Small group sizes for personalized fishing experience
Comfortable accommodations ranging from lodges to heated tent camps
Guests must bring their own rods, reels, and waders; guides carry flies, leaders, tips, and terminal tackle
No fishing license required except for Steelhead Creek Camp where it is included
Practice casting before arrival recommended; guides assist all skill levels
Sapsuk River Camp hosts max 6 anglers per week during king and silver salmon season, 4 anglers during steelhead season
Sandy River Lodge hosts up to 10 anglers during king season, 6 anglers during steelhead season
Steelhead Creek Camp hosts 2 anglers per week with single dedicated guide

blurb: Guests fly into Anchorage, then take charter flights to remote lodges or camps on the Alaska Peninsula. They enjoy six full days of guided fly fishing for king salmon, silver salmon, and steelhead in small groups with experienced guides. Accommodations range from lodges with shared bathrooms to heated tent camps with basic comforts.
